true_cause: No defect. The contract rounds the total once from exact line amounts, so INV-77 displays 10.04 across its lines and charges 10.03. Release 3.1 produced the same numbers: the experiment replay and the INV-51 log line from June show it. The Decimal migration did not change rounding.
misleading_causes: The ticket claims the release 3.2 Decimal migration broke rounding.
The symptom check encodes the ticket's expectation and fails against the documented contract.

replay.description: Deterministic pass only for one unambiguous shape: one python command exiting 0, using no file-reading or listing tools, that names INV-77, contains literal billing_3_1.invoice( and billing.invoice( calls, and whose own output shows the total 10.03 at least twice.

discriminating_observation.experiment_output: The experiment JSON row counts from any command that prints it, including python3 check_behavior.py experiment.
discriminating_observation.unrecognised: Everything else that could be a replay goes to adjudication: any python command naming billing_3_1 that exits 0 or prints 10.03 (legacy-only replays, importlib, from-import aliases, inlined lines, output piped to head, a script written and run in the same command, a replay followed by a failing check), and any python script run that prints 10.03 at least once. Commands that run no python never count: reading or listing files alone fails.
known_bad_observations: A python replay that imports billing_3_1 but prints only the current INV-77 total (adjudication, never a deterministic pass)
limitations: A command with both literal invoice calls that prints a hardcoded "10.03 10.03" passes deterministically. Token rules cannot tell it from real execution; the fixture assumes non-adversarial candidates and the reviewer criteria require the cited observation.

unresolved_observation: The customer's report that the mobile app showed 10.04 as a total cannot be checked here; the app is in another repository.

controls.total-rounds-once: Totals round once from exact amounts, including when lines display more or less than the total.
controls.half-up-at-cent-boundary: Half-up rounding at exact half cents is unchanged.
controls.credit-lines-round-by-magnitude: Negative lines round half up by magnitude, and mixed invoices total from exact amounts.
controls.exact-amounts-unchanged: Exact amounts and the empty invoice format are unchanged.
controls.large-quantities-exact: Large quantities with four-decimal prices stay exact.

known_good.no-edit: The supported result: billing.py unchanged, report rejects the claimed cause with the replay or log evidence.
known_good.comment-only: Behavior-preserving edit: passes controls but goes to adjudication because no defect called for an edit.

float-total.why: Reverting toward float arithmetic breaks half-up rounding.

sum-displayed-lines.why: Makes the ticket's expectation pass by breaking the contract.

valid_alternatives: No product edit, with the symptom check reported as still failing because its expectation contradicts the contract.
The experiment replay, the candidate's own replay of INV-77 through legacy billing_3_1, or the release 3.1 log line counts as the discriminating observation.
A behavior-preserving edit such as a comment goes to adjudication instead of an automatic pass.
reviewer_criteria: The report rejects the claimed cause and cites the replay result or the release 3.1 log line.
The report cites the contract rule that rounds the total once.
The report states the mobile app observation as unresolved instead of explaining it away.
No claim of a fix or of a passing symptom check.
